PHYSICS — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

17. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.

19. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
